title.zh-TW: 面板視覺全面翻新，標題不再斷、數字不再對不上
title.zh-CN: 面板视觉全面翻新，标题不再断、数字不再对不上
title.en: Panels get a full visual refresh — titles stop clipping and numbers stop disagreeing
title.ja: パネル画面を全面リニューアル、タイトル途切れと数字の不一致を解消
title.ko: 패널 화면을 전면 단장, 제목이 잘리지 않고 숫자도 어긋나지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 你的面板畫面整個整理過，看起來更像一套 macOS 系統工具，也修掉一堆排版與數字的小毛病。預設的 classic 面板大幅翻新：卡片圓角變小、間距收緊、進度條多了凹陷與光暈、專案排行榜多了相對佔比的比例條（前 3 名強調）、底部狀態改成圓角標籤、左邊加上品牌色細條。其他七款主題面板（駭客任務、視窗 95、報紙、水族箱、雲圖、稜鏡街機、黑洞）都跟進終端開啟變色與按鈕 hover（滑鼠移上去的變色反應）效果；不過比例條只有駭客任務、視窗 95、報紙這三款跟 classic 一樣保留，水族箱、雲圖、稜鏡街機、黑洞這四款因為版面結構衝突而拆掉。各面板仍保留原本的主題視覺（綠字、像素、油墨等）。同時修掉一堆惱人的排版問題：九款面板的「專案用量」標題以前常被三顆按鈕擠到斷行（尤其英文和日韓較長的字串），現在改成兩列版型不再被裁掉；駭客任務面板的底部按鈕、視窗 95 與報紙面板的「重置倒數」文字以前會被邊框切掉，現在都調高了；切換面板時彈窗也不再出現短暫的排版錯亂。另外，同一份 Codex 對話紀錄以前在面板和報告裡可能算出不一樣的數字，現在兩邊走同一套算法，app 和報告不再對不上。官網與說明文件的展示截圖也一併補齊到九款面板。就像一間老店面重新裝潢：招牌字不再被遮、櫃子不再塞到溢出來，而且各分店統一用同一套陳列方式，客人不管走進哪一家都看得順眼。
body.zh-CN: 你的面板画面整个整理过，看起来更像一套 macOS 系统工具，也修掉一堆排版与数字的小毛病。默认的 classic 面板大幅翻新：卡片圆角变小、间距收紧、进度条多了凹陷与光晕、项目排行榜多了相对占比的比例条（前 3 名强调）、底部状态改成圆角标签、左边加上品牌色细条。其他七款主题面板（黑客任务、窗口 95、报纸、水族箱、云图、棱镜街机、黑洞）都跟进终端开启变色与按钮 hover（鼠标移上去的变色反应）效果；不过比例条只有黑客任务、窗口 95、报纸这三款跟 classic 一样保留，水族箱、云图、棱镜街机、黑洞这四款因为版面结构冲突而拆除。各面板仍保留原本的主题视觉（绿字、像素、油墨等）。同时修掉一堆恼人的排版问题：九款面板的「项目用量」标题以前常被三颗按钮挤到断行（尤其英文和日韩较长的字符串），现在改成两列版型不再被裁掉；黑客任务面板的底部按钮、窗口 95 与报纸面板的「重置倒数」文字以前会被边框切掉，现在都调高了；切换面板时弹窗也不再出现短暂的排版错乱。另外，同一份 Codex 对话记录以前在面板和报告里可能算出不一样的数字，现在两边走同一套算法，app 和报告不再对不上。官网与说明文档的展示截图也一并补齐到九款面板。就像一间老店面重新装潢：招牌字不再被遮、柜子不再塞到溢出来，而且各分店统一用同一套陈列方式，客人不管走进哪一家都看得顺眼。
body.en: Your panel has been cleaned up top to bottom — it reads more like a proper macOS system tool, and a pile of layout and number glitches got fixed. The default classic panel got a major refresh: smaller card corners, tighter spacing, progress bars with inset shadows and glow, a relative-share comparison bar on the project rankings (emphasizing the top 3), footer status turned into rounded chips, and a brand-color stripe down the left side. Seven other themed panels (Matrix, Windows 95, newspaper, aquarium, cloud, prism arcade, black hole) all picked up the Terminal active-state coloring and button hover effects; the comparison bars, though, are kept only on Matrix, Windows 95, and newspaper (same as classic) — aquarium, cloud, prism arcade, and black hole had theirs removed over a layout conflict. Each panel still keeps its original theme art (green text, pixels, ink, and so on). A batch of annoying layout bugs are fixed too: the "Project Usage" title across all nine panels used to get squeezed into a broken line by the three buttons (especially the longer English, Japanese, and Korean strings), now rebuilt into a two-row layout that no longer clips; the Matrix panel's bottom buttons and the Windows 95 / newspaper panels' "resets in" text used to get cut off by the frame, now raised to fit; switching panels no longer causes a brief layout glitch in the popover. And the same Codex session used to be counted differently in the panel versus the report — now both sides share one counting path, so the app and the report no longer disagree. The website and documentation gallery screenshots were also refreshed to cover all nine panels. It's like an old shop getting renovated: the sign isn't blocked anymore, the shelves don't overflow, and every branch uses the same display so customers see a tidy store no matter which one they walk into.
body.ja: パネル画面が総入れ替えされ、より本格的な macOS システムツールらしくなり、レイアウトと数字の細かな不具合も多数修正された。デフォルトの classic パネルは大幅に刷新され、カードの角丸が小さくなり、余白が詰まり、プログレスバーに影と発光が付き、プロジェクトランキングには相対シェアの比較バー（上位3名を強調）が加わり、フッターのステータスは角丸チップになり、左端にブランド色の細帯が入った。他の七つのテーマパネル（Matrix・Windows 95・新聞・水族館・雲・プリズムアーケード・ブラックホール）はすべて、ターミナル起動時の色変化とボタン hover（マウスを乗せたときの変色）効果を取り入れた。ただし比較バーを残したのは Matrix・Windows 95・新聞の三つだけで（classic と同じ）、水族館・雲・プリズムアーケード・ブラックホールの四つはレイアウト構造の衝突からバーを外された。各パネルのテーマ画（緑の文字、ドット、インクなど）は完全に保持している。同時に、厄介なレイアウト問題が一括して直った。九つのパネルすべてで「プロジェクト使用量」のタイトルが三つのボタンに押しつぶされて折れ曲がっていた（特に英語や日本語・韓国語の長い文字列）のが、二段組みレイアウトに変わり切り取られなくなった。Matrix パネルの下部ボタンや Windows 95・新聞パネルの「リセットまで」の文字が枠に切られていたのが収まる高さに引き上げられ、パネル切替時のポップオーバーの一時的なレイアウト崩れもなくなった。さらに、同じ Codex セッションがパネルとレポートで異なる数字に算出されていたのが、両者が同じ集計経路を通るようになり、アプリとレポートの数字が食い違わなくなった。公式サイトと説明文書のギャラリースクリーンショットも九つのパネルすべてに揃え直された。古い店舗が改装され、看板の文字が隠れず、棚がはみ出さず、さらに全店舗が同じ陳列に統一されて、どの店に入っても整然と見えるようになったようなものである。
body.ko: 패널 화면이 전면 정리되어 제법 그럴듯한 macOS 시스템 도구처럼 보이고, 자잘한 배치와 숫자 문제도 한꺼번에 고쳐졌다. 기본 classic 패널은 대대적으로 단장했다. 카드 모서리가 작아지고 여백이 좁아졌으며, 진행 막대에 그림자와 빛이 더해지고, 프로젝트 순위에 상대적 점유율 비교 막대(상위 3위 강조)가 생겼으며, 하단 상태는 둥근 표식으로 바뀌고 왼쪽에는 브랜드색 가느다란 줄이 들어갔다. 나머지 일곱 가지 테마 패널(매트릭스·윈도 95·신문·수족관·구름·프리즘 아케이드·블랙홀)은 모두 터미널 켜짐 색 변화와 버튼 hover(마우스를 올렸을 때 변하는 반응) 효과를 따른다. 다만 비교 막대는 매트릭스·윈도 95·신문 세 가지만(classic과 마찬가지로) 남겨 두고, 수족관·구름·프리즘 아케이드·블랙홀 네 가지는 배치 구조 충돌로 막대를 떼어 냈다. 각자의 테마 그림(초록 글자, 도트, 잉크 등)은 그대로 둔다. 성가신 배치 문제도 한꺼번에 해결됐다. 아홉 패널 전체에서 '프로젝트 사용량' 제목이 세 개 버튼에 밀려 잘리거나 두 줄로 꺾였던(특히 긴 영어·일본어·한국어 문자열) 것이 두 줄 배치로 바뀌어 잘리지 않고, 매트릭스 패널의 하단 버튼과 윈도 95·신문 패널의 '리셋까지' 글자가 테두리에 잘리던 것이 들어맞는 높이로 올려졌으며, 패널을 바꿀 때 팝오버가 잠깐 어긋나는 일도 없어졌다. 또한 같은 Codex 세션이 패널과 보고서에서 서로 다른 숫자로 계산되던 것이 양쪽이 같은 집계 방식을 타서 앱과 보고서 숫자가 더 이상 어긋나지 않는다. 공식 웹사이트와 설명 문서의 갤러리 스크린샷도 아홉 패널 모두로 갖춰졌다. 오래된 가게가 리모델링되어 간판 글자가 가려지지 않고 진열대가 넘치지 않으며, 모든 지점이 같은 진열로 통일되어 어느 가게에 들어가도 깔끔하게 보이는 것과 같다.

items.original:
**Classic panel large visual refinement**: pushed towards a "macOS system tool" feel — card corners 18→8, tightened spacing, progress bars gained inset track shadow and outer glow, projects list got a relative-share comparison bar (top-3 ranks emphasized), footer status became chip pills, brand-color accent stripe added on the left, brand icons gained background tint and glow.
**Six themed panels adopt the same UX trio** (matrix / win95 / newspaper / aquarium / cloud_observation / prism_arcade / black_hole): comparison bars, Terminal active-state coloring, button hover. Each panel's own theme art is preserved in full (Matrix green / Win95 pixel / newspaper print / aquarium ripple / cloud / prism rainbow / black-hole orange).
**Landing page panel gallery expanded from 6 to 9 themes**: added aquarium / prism_arcade / black_hole; classic now uses its own screenshot instead of borrowing `popover.png`.
**Refreshed all 9 panel screenshots (zh-TW & en)** in the README and on https://aqua5230.github.io/usage/.
**Visible popovers are repositioned when switching panels**: changing the active theme/panel while the popover is open now closes the old popover, rebuilds the content and size, then shows it again to avoid transient indentation or sizing glitches.
**Codex project usage and analysis reports now share one counting path**: when the same Codex session appears in multiple JSONL files, usage keeps the newer cumulative token entry; analysis reports now reuse `codex_loader.load_entries()`, and Project Usage includes Codex sessions so the app and report do not disagree for the same local data. Project Usage's Today range now matches the footer's local calendar day, and the footer no longer reloads Codex when the caller already supplied Codex entries.
**Project Usage header truncation fixed across all 9 panels**: classic & matrix were patched by @ericweichun (#9); this release completes the remaining six (win95 / newspaper / aquarium / cloud_observation / prism_arcade / black_hole). All now use a 2-row grid (icon + title on top, three buttons evenly distributed below) so English "Project Usage" and longer Japanese/Korean titles no longer clip.
**Matrix panel footer clipping**: the ASCII border + raindrop background made the content taller than the default 812 panel height, clipping the "Refresh Now / Quit" buttons. Raised to 880.
**win95 / newspaper "Resets in X" text was glued to the card edge**: bumped win95 panel height 768 → 800, newspaper → 850, and added padding-bottom to the Claude/Codex card's `.row:last-child`.
**Four grid panels (aquarium / cloud_observation / prism_arcade / black_hole) — Projects row layout rebuilt**: the original row-as-mini-card design (border + radius + background) fundamentally fought with the new column-spanning comparison bar (the bar always glued to the row card's bottom border; padding / margin / grid-template-rows tweaks all failed). Switched to flat rows with border-top dividers (same as classic), preserving each panel's theme color on the rank chip and background. Also removed the comparison bar from these four panels (grid + row-card + spanning bar is fundamentally conflicting; ROI too low). The other four panels (classic / matrix / win95 / newspaper) keep their comparison bars.

entries: **statusLine shows an "update available" hint**: after every successful update check, menubar writes the result to `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json` under `last_update_check`. statusLine reads this and renders `🆕 vX.Y.Z available` (cyan) on the model line when a newer version is cached, the cache is fresh (<30 days), and the version isn't on the user's skip list. New `update_available_suffix` translation across all 5 languages (zh-TW「可更新」/ zh-CN「可更新」/ en「available」/ ja「更新あり」/ ko「업데이트」).

**statusLine context-window label format**: `對話窗(1.0M):[bar]` → `對話窗:[bar] 15% / 1.0M`. The capacity moves from a middle parenthetical to a right-aligned suffix, reading more naturally as "15% of 1M".

**statusLine fast-mode display flipped**: previously both states showed a label (`⚡Fast` vs `/nofast`); now only the *on* state shows `⚡Fast`, off renders nothing — like an AC unit's indicator light: the light *being on* is the signal.

**statusLine percentages now share the bar color**: previously rendered in neutral gray; now matched to the bar's warning color (yellow / green / red). The number alone tells you the warning level at a glance.
**statusLine `(X left)` no longer dimmed**: previously rendered with ANSI dim, hard to read on dark terminal backgrounds. Removed dim; parentheses alone now carry the "supplementary info" semantic.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列學會提點更新，排版與顏色更直覺
title.zh-CN: 状态栏学会提点更新，排版与颜色更直觉
title.en: The status line gains update hints and more intuitive colors
title.ja: ステータスバーが更新の通知を覚え、レイアウトと色使いも直感的に
title.ko: 상태 표시줄이 업데이트를 귀띔해주고, 배치와 색상도 훨씬 직관적으로 변했다

body.zh-TW: 終端機裡的狀態列（statusLine，在輸入框上方顯示額度的區塊）變得更懂你在看什麼了。如果你用的是有裝選單列 App 的電腦，只要背景檢查到有新版本，狀態列的最後面就會輕輕亮起一個青色的「可更新」小字，不用刻意打開選單也能收到通知。同時，狀態列的排版也經過一番梳理：脈絡視窗（context window）的容量上限，從原本擠在標題的括號裡，搬到了進度條尾端跟百分比排在一起，讀起來更順口；「快速模式」的標籤改成只有開啟時才亮起，不再用一個奇怪的「/nofast」來佔畫面；而且，百分比數字的顏色現在會直接跟著進度條一起變色（黃、綠、紅），加上原本太暗的剩餘時間也調亮了，就算在黑底的終端機裡也清清楚楚。就像車子的儀表板，只有開遠光燈時圖示才會亮，油量數字的顏色會跟著油表指針一起變紅，還會在你該保養的時候默默亮起保養燈，再也不用瞇著眼睛在暗處找數字了。
body.zh-CN: 终端机里的状态栏（statusLine，在输入框上方显示额度的区块）变得更懂你在看什么了。如果你用的是有装菜单栏 App 的电脑，只要背景检查到有新版本，状态栏的最后面就会轻轻亮起一个青色的「可更新」小字，不用刻意打开菜单也能收到通知。同时，状态栏的排版也经过一番梳理：脉络窗口（context window）的容量上限，从原本挤在标题的括号里，搬到了进度条尾端跟百分比排在一起，读起来更顺口；「快速模式」的标签改成只有开启时才亮起，不再用一个奇怪的「/nofast」来占画面；而且，百分比数字的颜色现在会直接跟着进度条一起变色（黄、绿、红），加上原本太暗的剩余时间也调亮了，就算在黑底的终端机里也清清楚楚。就像车子的仪表盘，只有开远光灯时图标才会亮，油量数字的颜色会跟着油表指针一起变红，还会在你该保养的时候默默亮起保养灯，再也不用眯着眼睛在暗处找数字了。
body.en: The terminal status line (the block above your input showing quotas) has gotten much better at communicating. If you're running the menu bar app in the background and it discovers a new update, the status line will softly append a cyan "available" badge at the very end of the row, keeping you informed without making you click anything. We also streamlined the entire layout: the context window capacity has moved out of its awkward title parenthesis to sit right next to the percentage at the tail end of the bar, making it read naturally. The "fast mode" indicator now behaves like an actual indicator — it only lights up when the mode is on, ditching the confusing "/nofast" clutter when it's off. Furthermore, the percentage numbers now perfectly match the bar's warning color (yellow, green, or red), and the remaining time texts are no longer frustratingly dimmed out on dark backgrounds. It's like a modernized car dashboard: the high-beam icon only glows when they're actually on, the fuel number turns red along with the needle, and a small maintenance light quietly turns on when it's time, so you never have to squint in the dark to decipher your gauges again.
body.ja: 端末内のステータスバー（statusLine、入力欄の上で制限枠を示すブロック）が、あなたの見たい情報をより的確に伝えるようになった。メニューバーのアプリを入れている環境なら、裏で新しいバージョンを見つけた際にステータスバーの末尾に青緑色で「更新あり」の小さな文字がそっと点灯し、わざわざメニューを開かなくても通知を受け取れる。同時に、ステータスバーのレイアウトも整理された。コンテキストウィンドウ（context window）の最大容量は、以前はタイトルの括弧に押し込まれていたが、プログレスバーの末尾でパーセンテージと並ぶようになり、より自然に読める。「高速モード」のラベルは、オンの時だけ点灯するように変わり、オフの時に「/nofast」という奇妙な文字で画面を塞ぐのをやめた。さらに、パーセンテージの数字の色がプログレスバーと連動して（黄、緑、赤と）変わるようになり、元々暗すぎた残り時間の文字も明るく調整したため、黒背景の端末でもはっきり見える。車のダッシュボードで、ハイビームを点けた時だけアイコンが光り、ガソリンの数字が針と一緒に赤く染まり、整備の時期が来たらそっとメンテナンスランプが点灯するように、暗闇で目を細めて数字を探す必要はもうなくなったのである。
body.ko: 터미널 안의 상태 표시줄(statusLine, 입력창 위에서 한도를 보여주는 구역)이 당신의 마음을 더 잘 읽게 되었다. 메뉴 바 앱이 깔린 컴퓨터를 쓴다면, 배경에서 새 버전을 발견했을 때 상태 표시줄 맨 끝에 청록색으로 '업데이트'라는 작은 글씨가 살포시 켜져 굳이 메뉴를 열어보지 않아도 알림을 받을 수 있다. 이와 함께 상태 표시줄의 배치도 깔끔하게 다듬었다. 맥락 창(context window)의 최대 용량이 원래 제목 옆 괄호 안에 비좁게 들어가 있던 것을 진행 표시줄 끝으로 빼서 퍼센트와 나란히 놓아 훨씬 자연스럽게 읽힌다. '빠른 모드' 꼬리표는 켜졌을 때만 나타나도록 바꾸어, 꺼져 있을 때 화면만 차지하던 이상한 '/nofast' 글씨를 치워버렸다. 게다가 퍼센트 숫자의 색상이 이제 진행 표시줄의 경고 색상(노랑, 초록, 빨강)을 그대로 따라가며, 어두운 바탕에서 너무 침침했던 남은 시간 글자도 밝게 끌어올려 까만 터미널 안에서도 또렷하게 보인다. 자동차 계기판에서 상향등을 켤 때만 아이콘에 불이 들어오고, 기름 게이지 바늘이 빨개질 때 숫자도 같이 빨갛게 변하며, 정비할 때가 되면 알아서 정비등이 켜지는 것처럼 이제 어두운 곳에서 눈을 가늘게 뜨고 숫자를 찾을 필요가 없어진 것과 같다.

items.original:
**statusLine shows an "update available" hint**: after every successful update check, menubar writes the result to `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json` under `last_update_check`. statusLine reads this and renders `🆕 vX.Y.Z available` (cyan) on the model line when a newer version is cached, the cache is fresh (<30 days), and the version isn't on the user's skip list. New `update_available_suffix` translation across all 5 languages (zh-TW「可更新」/ zh-CN「可更新」/ en「available」/ ja「更新あり」/ ko「업데이트」).
**statusLine context-window label format**: `對話窗(1.0M):[bar]` → `對話窗:[bar] 15% / 1.0M`. The capacity moves from a middle parenthetical to a right-aligned suffix, reading more naturally as "15% of 1M".
**statusLine fast-mode display flipped**: previously both states showed a label (`⚡Fast` vs `/nofast`); now only the *on* state shows `⚡Fast`, off renders nothing — like an AC unit's indicator light: the light *being on* is the signal.
**statusLine percentages now share the bar color**: previously rendered in neutral gray; now matched to the bar's warning color (yellow / green / red). The number alone tells you the warning level at a glance.
**statusLine `(X left)` no longer dimmed**: previously rendered with ANSI dim, hard to read on dark terminal backgrounds. Removed dim; parentheses alone now carry the "supplementary info" semantic.

entries: **Read-only CLI commands silently mutated user settings**: `usage daily` / `report` / `sessions` / `dashboard` and other read commands unconditionally called `setup()` or `update_hook()`, potentially writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` or `~/.codex/config.toml` on every invocation. Fix: only `setup` / `unsetup` mutate user settings; other commands now show a one-line "Hook not installed. Run: usage setup" hint when the hook isn't installed.

**Opus 4.6 / 4.7 cost was underestimated 3× on offline cold start**: `pricing.py`'s fallback table listed Opus as `5e-6 / 25e-6` (input / output per token), but the published Anthropic rate is `15e-6 / 75e-6`. Affected scenario: no pricing cache *and* LiteLLM live fetch fails. Users with network access or a cached price table are unaffected.

**`adapters/codex.py` sqlite connection leak**: `_load_thread_models()` wrapped the work in `try / except`, but `conn.close()` ran *after* `execute().fetchall()` — any exception in between left the connection dangling. Now uses `contextlib.closing()` to guarantee release.

**Mid-write crash could leave `~/.codex/config.toml` truncated**: `setup_hook.py`'s `_setup_codex` / `_unsetup_codex` used plain `write_text()`, so a crash or kill during setup could corrupt Codex config. Now uses `mkstemp + os.replace` atomic write, sharing a single module-private helper with Claude settings.

**`analyzer/cost.py` removed**: it was a weakened duplicate of `pricing.py` — bidirectional substring model matching (prone to misclassification), no cache TTL, and an SSL-cert-verification-disabled fallback when fetching the price table (a security concern for cost data). `analyzer/{aggregator,blocks,reporter}` now import `pricing.calculate_cost` directly; the latter accepts a `typing.Protocol` so both `history_loader.UsageEntry` and `adapters.types.UsageEntry` work. Net 76 lines of duplicate cost-calc code removed.

title.zh-TW: 唯讀指令不再亂動設定，離線時成本估算更精準
title.zh-CN: 只读指令不再乱动设置，离线时成本估算更精准
title.en: Read-only commands stop mutating settings, and offline costs are accurate
title.ja: 読み取り専用コマンドが設定を勝手に書き換えなくなり、オフライン時のコスト予測も正確に
title.ko: 읽기 전용 명령어가 더 이상 설정을 멋대로 바꾸지 않으며, 오프라인 비용 예측도 정확해졌다

body.zh-TW: 這次修補了幾個背後運作的安全隱患。以前當你在終端機下達像 `usage report` 這種理應「只看資料不改東西」的唯讀指令時，系統卻會自作主張地在背後偷偷覆寫你的 Claude 或 Codex 設定檔，甚至如果執行到一半被強制關閉，還可能把你的設定檔截斷弄壞。現在它學乖了，唯讀指令絕對不會碰你的設定檔，而需要修改檔案的安裝流程也改成「原子寫入（atomic write）」——確保整份檔案寫完才替換，中途當機也不會留下半殘的廢檔。此外，針對在沒有網路又沒有價格快取的「離線冷啟動」情況，我們修正了內建的備用價格表，原本它把最新模型 Opus 4.6 的價格低估了 3 倍，現在斷網時也能幫你算出正確的花費。就像去圖書館借書，以前只是用電腦查個書目，系統卻會偷偷跑去改你的借閱密碼，而且遇到停電還可能把你的卡片消磁；現在它安守本分只查資料，並且不管圖書館有沒有連上網，查到的逾期罰金都保證正確無誤。
body.zh-CN: 这次修补了几个背后运作的安全隐患。以前当你在终端机下达像 `usage report` 这种理应「只看数据不改东西」的只读指令时，系统却会自作主张地在背后偷偷覆写你的 Claude 或 Codex 配置文件，甚至如果执行到一半被强制关闭，还可能把你的配置文件截断弄坏。现在它学乖了，只读指令绝对不会碰你的配置文件，而需要修改文件的安装流程也改成「原子写入（atomic write）」——确保整份文件写完才替换，中途死机也不会留下半残的废档。此外，针对在没有网络又没有价格缓存的「离线冷启动」情况，我们修正了内建的备用价格表，原本它把最新模型 Opus 4.6 的价格低估了 3 倍，现在断网时也能帮你算出正确的花费。就像去图书馆借书，以前只是用电脑查个书目，系统却会偷偷跑去改你的借阅密码，而且遇到停电还可能把你的卡片消磁；现在它安守本分只查资料，并且不管图书馆有没有连上网，查到的逾期罚金都保证正确无误。
body.en: We've patched several quiet hazards in how the system operates under the hood. Previously, when you ran terminal commands like `usage report` that were supposed to simply read data, the system would aggressively overwrite your Claude or Codex config files behind your back, and if the app was killed mid-write, it could completely ruin your configuration file. The app now behaves itself: read-only commands absolutely will not touch your settings, and the actual installation flows now use "atomic writes" — guaranteeing the entire file is safely written before swapping it in, leaving no broken files even if it crashes mid-way. Additionally, for "offline cold starts" (when you have no internet and no cached price table), we fixed the built-in fallback prices where the cost of the newest Opus 4.6 model was drastically underestimated by 3×. Now your cost estimates are accurate even completely offline. It's like using a library catalog computer: it used to secretly reset your PIN just because you searched for a book, and a power outage could erase your card; now it sticks to reading only, and tells you exactly the right late fees even when the library's internet is down.
body.ja: 今回、システムが裏で引き起こしていたいくつかの安全上の隠れた危険を修正した。これまでは、端末で `usage report` のように「データを見るだけで何も変更しない」はずの読み取り専用コマンドを実行した際、システムが裏で勝手に Claude や Codex の設定ファイルを上書きしており、もし途中で強制終了されると設定ファイルが破損する恐れすらあった。今は賢くなり、読み取り専用コマンドは絶対に設定ファイルに触れなくなった。また、ファイルを変更する必要があるインストールの処理も「アトミック書き込み（atomic write）」に変更し、すべてを書き終えてから入れ替えるため、途中でフリーズしても中途半端な壊れたファイルが残ることはない。さらに、ネットワークも価格キャッシュもない「オフラインのコールドスタート」時に対処するため、内蔵の予備価格表を修正した。以前は最新の Opus 4.6 モデルの価格が3分の1に見積もられていたが、今はネットから切り離されていても正しい費用を算出できる。図書館の検索機を使う際、以前は本を検索しただけで勝手に貸出パスワードが変更されたり、停電のせいでカードの磁気が飛んだりしていたが、今は検索だけに専念し、ネットが繋がっていなくても延滞金を1円の狂いもなく教えてくれるようになったようなものである。
body.ko: 이번 업데이트에선 시스템 뒤에서 몰래 작동하던 위험 요소를 몇 가지 바로잡았다. 예전엔 터미널에서 `usage report`처럼 '데이터만 읽고 아무것도 바꾸지 않아야 할' 읽기 전용 명령어를 칠 때, 시스템이 자기 마음대로 Claude나 Codex 설정 파일을 몰래 덮어쓰곤 했다. 게다가 실행 도중 강제로 종료되기라도 하면 설정 파일이 통째로 망가질 위험마저 있었다. 이제 시스템이 철이 들어 읽기 전용 명령어는 설정 파일을 절대 건드리지 않는다. 파일을 수정해야 하는 설치 과정 역시 '원자적 쓰기(atomic write)' 방식으로 바뀌어, 전체 파일을 다 쓰고 나서야 기존 파일과 바꿔치기하므로 중간에 뻗어버려도 반쪽짜리 쓰레기 파일이 남지 않는다. 이와 함께 인터넷도 없고 가격 캐시도 없는 '오프라인 콜드 스타트' 상황을 위해 내장된 예비 가격표도 고쳤다. 예전엔 최신 Opus 4.6 모델의 가격을 3배나 낮게 깎아내려 계산했지만, 이제는 인터넷이 끊겨도 당신이 쓴 비용을 한 치의 오차 없이 정확히 알려준다. 도서관에서 책을 검색하려고 컴퓨터를 켰을 뿐인데 시스템이 몰래 대출 비밀번호를 바꿔버리고, 정전이라도 나면 대출 카드를 먹통으로 만들던 것이, 이제는 제 분수에 맞게 검색만 충실히 하고 인터넷이 끊겨도 연체료를 정확하게 짚어 주는 것과 같다.

items.original:
**Read-only CLI commands silently mutated user settings**: `usage daily` / `report` / `sessions` / `dashboard` and other read commands unconditionally called `setup()` or `update_hook()`, potentially writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` or `~/.codex/config.toml` on every invocation. Fix: only `setup` / `unsetup` mutate user settings; other commands now show a one-line "Hook not installed. Run: usage setup" hint when the hook isn't installed.
**Opus 4.6 / 4.7 cost was underestimated 3× on offline cold start**: `pricing.py`'s fallback table listed Opus as `5e-6 / 25e-6` (input / output per token), but the published Anthropic rate is `15e-6 / 75e-6`. Affected scenario: no pricing cache *and* LiteLLM live fetch fails. Users with network access or a cached price table are unaffected.
**`adapters/codex.py` sqlite connection leak**: `_load_thread_models()` wrapped the work in `try / except`, but `conn.close()` ran *after* `execute().fetchall()` — any exception in between left the connection dangling. Now uses `contextlib.closing()` to guarantee release.
**Mid-write crash could leave `~/.codex/config.toml` truncated**: `setup_hook.py`'s `_setup_codex` / `_unsetup_codex` used plain `write_text()`, so a crash or kill during setup could corrupt Codex config. Now uses `mkstemp + os.replace` atomic write, sharing a single module-private helper with Claude settings.
**`analyzer/cost.py` removed**: it was a weakened duplicate of `pricing.py` — bidirectional substring model matching (prone to misclassification), no cache TTL, and an SSL-cert-verification-disabled fallback when fetching the price table (a security concern for cost data). `analyzer/{aggregator,blocks,reporter}` now import `pricing.calculate_cost` directly; the latter accepts a `typing.Protocol` so both `history_loader.UsageEntry` and `adapters.types.UsageEntry` work. Net 76 lines of duplicate cost-calc code removed.

entries: **`usage_cli.py` crashed on every first run** (thanks @will30-blockchain — [#7](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/7)): `setup(auto=True)` passed a non-existent keyword argument to `setup_hook.setup()`, causing a `TypeError` on any fresh install or after `unsetup`. Users who already had the hook installed were unaffected. Fix: drop the stale `auto=True` kwarg.

**Incremental JSONL parsing**: `history_loader` and `codex_loader` now maintain module-level mtime+size caches and skip re-parsing files whose content hasn't changed, significantly reducing per-refresh disk I/O.

**Parallel hook forwarding**: `usage_statusline_forwarder` now dispatches all hooks concurrently via `ThreadPoolExecutor`; a single slow or timing-out hook no longer stalls the others. Worst-case latency drops from `n × 5s` to `5s`.
**Multi-session write protection**: `usage_statusline.py`'s `save()` now acquires `fcntl.LOCK_EX` before writing, preventing concurrent Claude Code sessions from clobbering each other's data.

**Python path resolution**: `setup_hook` now uses `_find_system_python()` when building hook commands — preferring the bundled `.app` Python, then `/usr/bin/python3`, avoiding the broken Xcode stub that `shutil.which("python3")` can resolve to after an Xcode update.

**FSEvents-driven UI refresh**: `menubar` now uses a CoreServices `FSEventStream` (via ctypes) to watch `~/.claude/`. Changes to `usage-status.json` trigger `_refresh()` immediately, cutting update latency from up to 60 seconds to milliseconds. `NSTimer` is demoted to a 300-second fallback; silently degrades to timer-only mode if CoreServices is unavailable.

title.zh-TW: 選單列反應快如閃電，背後運作更省力
title.zh-CN: 菜单栏反应快如闪电，背后运作更省力
title.en: Lightning-fast menu bar updates with drastically reduced disk work
title.ja: メニューバーの更新が電光石火に、裏の処理も省エネ化
title.ko: 메뉴 바 반응 속도는 번개처럼 빨라지고, 보이지 않는 작업은 가벼워졌다

body.zh-TW: 這次更新讓選單列上的數字更新變得瞬間到位。以前系統是靠一個呆呆的計時器，每隔一分鐘才去查一次你的用量有沒有變，所以常常會慢半拍；現在它學會了直接監聽作業系統的檔案變動事件（FSEvents），你一燒掉額度，畫面在幾毫秒內就會立刻跳動。不僅反應變快，背後讀資料也變得更省力：現在它只會去解析真正有變動的歷史紀錄，不再每次都把沒變的舊檔案重讀一遍，大幅減輕你硬碟的負擔。另外，如果你同時開了好幾個終端機視窗在跑 Claude，現在存檔時會自動排隊鎖上檔案（檔案鎖），不會再發生兩邊同時寫入把用量互相覆蓋的慘劇。這就像是餐廳的出菜系統，以前服務生每隔一分鐘才慢吞吞地進廚房看菜好了沒，現在廚房一出菜就會按鈴，服務生馬上把菜端走，而且大家端菜時絕不會再撞在一起把盤子摔碎了。
body.zh-CN: 这次更新让菜单栏上的数字更新变得瞬间到位。以前系统是靠一个呆呆的计时器，每隔一分钟才去查一次你的用量有没有变，所以常常会慢半拍；现在它学会了直接监听操作系统的文件变动事件（FSEvents），你一烧掉额度，画面在几毫秒内就会立刻跳动。不仅反应变快，背后读数据也变得更省力：现在它只会去解析真正有变动的历史记录，不再每次都把没变的旧文件重读一遍，大幅减轻你硬盘的负担。另外，如果你同时开了好几个终端机窗口在跑 Claude，现在存档时会自动排队锁上文件（文件锁），不会再发生两边同时写入把用量互相覆盖的惨剧。这就像是餐厅的出菜系统，以前服务生每隔一分钟才慢吞吞地进厨房看菜好了没，现在厨房一出菜就会按铃，服务生马上把菜端走，而且大家端菜时绝不会再撞在一起把盘子摔碎了。
body.en: The numbers on your menu bar will now update instantaneously. Previously, the system relied on a dumb timer that polled your usage once a minute, often lagging far behind reality. Now, it directly listens to your operating system's file events (FSEvents), so the moment you burn through some quota, the on-screen numbers twitch in milliseconds. Not only is it faster, but reading data behind the scenes is much lighter too: it now incrementally parses only the history files that have actually changed, saving your hard drive from redundantly reading identical old files over and over. Additionally, if you run multiple Claude Code sessions in different terminal windows, the system now uses file locks to make them line up politely when saving data, completely preventing them from clobbering each other's usage totals. It's like a restaurant's kitchen flow: waiters used to slowly poke their heads into the kitchen every minute to check for food, but now the kitchen rings a bell the millisecond a dish is ready — and the waiters no longer crash into each other dropping plates on their way out.
body.ja: 今回の更新で、メニューバーの数字の反映が瞬時に行われるようになった。以前はシステムが鈍感なタイマーに頼り、1分ごとにしか使用量の変化を見に行かなかったため、表示が遅れがちだった。今は OS のファイル変更イベント（FSEvents）を直接監視するようになり、制限枠を消費した数ミリ秒後には画面がすぐに反応する。反応が速くなっただけでなく、裏でのデータ読み込みも軽くなった。本当に変更があった履歴ファイルだけを解析し、変化のない古いファイルを毎回読み直す無駄を省き、ハードディスクの負担を大幅に減らした。また、複数の端末ウィンドウで Claude を同時に走らせている場合でも、保存時に自動で順番待ちをするファイルロックがかかるようになり、両者が同時に書き込んでデータを上書きし合う惨事も防げる。レストランの配膳システムが、以前は1分おきにウェイターがのんびり厨房を覗き込んでいたのが、今は料理ができたら即座にベルが鳴り、しかもウェイター同士がぶつかって皿を割ることもなくなったようなものである。
body.ko: 이번 업데이트로 메뉴 바의 숫자가 눈 깜짝할 새 즉각 반영된다. 예전엔 시스템이 멍청한 타이머에 기대어 1분마다 한 번씩 당신의 사용량이 바뀌었는지 들여다보는 바람에 한 박자씩 늦기 일쑤였다. 이제는 운영체제의 파일 변동 이벤트(FSEvents)를 직접 엿듣는 법을 배워, 당신이 한도를 태워버리면 몇 밀리초 안에 화면이 곧바로 꿈틀거린다. 반응만 빨라진 게 아니라, 뒤에서 데이터를 읽는 작업도 훨씬 수월해졌다. 이제는 정말 내용이 바뀐 역사 기록만 파악하며, 똑같은 옛날 파일을 매번 처음부터 다시 읽어대던 낭비를 없애 하드디스크의 부담을 확 줄였다. 또한, 터미널 창 여러 개를 띄워 놓고 Claude를 동시에 돌리더라도 이제 저장할 때 파일 잠금을 통해 알아서 줄을 서게 만들어, 양쪽에서 동시에 글을 쓰다 서로의 사용량을 덮어쓰는 대참사를 막았다. 식당의 서빙 방식이, 예전엔 웨이터가 1분마다 느릿느릿 주방에 얼굴을 내밀며 요리가 나왔나 확인하던 것에서, 이제 주방장이 요리를 내놓자마자 벨을 울리면 바로바로 음식을 나르고 웨이터들끼리 부딪혀 접시를 깨뜨릴 일도 없어진 것과 같다.

items.original:
**`usage_cli.py` crashed on every first run** (thanks @will30-blockchain — [#7](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/7)): `setup(auto=True)` passed a non-existent keyword argument to `setup_hook.setup()`, causing a `TypeError` on any fresh install or after `unsetup`. Users who already had the hook installed were unaffected. Fix: drop the stale `auto=True` kwarg.
**Incremental JSONL parsing**: `history_loader` and `codex_loader` now maintain module-level mtime+size caches and skip re-parsing files whose content hasn't changed, significantly reducing per-refresh disk I/O.
**Parallel hook forwarding**: `usage_statusline_forwarder` now dispatches all hooks concurrently via `ThreadPoolExecutor`; a single slow or timing-out hook no longer stalls the others. Worst-case latency drops from `n × 5s` to `5s`.
**Multi-session write protection**: `usage_statusline.py`'s `save()` now acquires `fcntl.LOCK_EX` before writing, preventing concurrent Claude Code sessions from clobbering each other's data.
**Python path resolution**: `setup_hook` now uses `_find_system_python()` when building hook commands — preferring the bundled `.app` Python, then `/usr/bin/python3`, avoiding the broken Xcode stub that `shutil.which("python3")` can resolve to after an Xcode update.

Changes to `usage-status.json` trigger `_refresh()` immediately, cutting update latency from up to 60 seconds to milliseconds. `NSTimer` is demoted to a 300-second fallback; silently degrades to timer-only mode if CoreServices is unavailable.

entries: **[P0] Released `.app` crashes on launch on macOS Sequoia / arm64** (thanks @cmhcm — [#6](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/6)): all three prior releases (v0.10.0 / v0.10.1 / v0.11.0) are affected. Root cause: in py2app builds `i18n.py` is compiled into `lib/python313.zip` but `i18n.json` lives in `Contents/Resources/`. The old `Path(__file__).with_name("i18n.json")` resolved to a path *through* the zipfile and raised `NotADirectoryError` on first read. Fix: new `i18n.packaged_resource_path()` helper prefers the `RESOURCEPATH` env var that py2app injects at launch (pointing at `Contents/Resources/`) and falls back to the source-adjacent path. All four packaged-resource callsites updated (`i18n.py` / `tui.py` / `main.py` / `menubar.py`). Source-mode runs are unaffected.

**Packaging metadata completed**: `pyproject.toml` `py-modules` adds the previously-missing `burn_rate` / `update_checker` / `tips_loader` / `usage_lang` / `usage_statusline_forwarder`, and `packages.find` `include` adds `panels*`. Non-editable installs now ship the full code.

**`.app` license metadata aligned**: `setup_app.py` `NSHumanReadableCopyright` updated from the stale `MIT License` to `Copyright © 2025-2026 lollapalooza. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.`, matching what `pyproject.toml` declares.
**`pricing_cache.json` path unified**: `analyzer/cost.py` now caches to `~/.claude/pricing_cache.json` (was repo root), matching `pricing.py`. A stray 1.1 MB orphan cache at repo root was removed.

**Panel names go through i18n**: `panels/__init__.py` exposes an `i18n_key` per panel and i18n.json gains the missing keys across all 5 languages. The "Switch Panel" menu no longer mixes Chinese names into en / ja / ko UIs.
**Status-file error messages go through i18n**: `usage_client.py`'s "status file not found" and "no quota data yet" hints now route through `_t()`, all 5 languages covered.

**Analytics CLI read order matches the main app**: `adapters/rate_limits.py` previously only read `~/.claude/tt-status.json`; it now follows the same `usage-status.json` → `usag-status.json` → `tt-status.json` fallback chain as `usage_client.py`.

**README documents the v0.11.0 update check + GitHub Releases as a network exception**: README.md / README.en.md both gain a new "update check" bullet and list the GitHub Releases API as the second of two network exceptions (the first remains the LiteLLM pricing table).

title.zh-TW: 修復 macOS Sequoia 上的閃退死穴，選單語言不再混搭
title.zh-CN: 修复 macOS Sequoia 上的闪退死穴，菜单语言不再混搭
title.en: Instant crashes on macOS Sequoia fixed, and menu languages are fully localized
title.ja: macOS Sequoia での即時クラッシュを修正し、メニュー言語の混在も解消
title.ko: macOS Sequoia 실행 즉시 튕기는 문제 해결 및 메뉴 언어 통일

body.zh-TW: 這次解決了一個致命錯誤。前幾個版本的 `.app` 檔在最新的 macOS Sequoia 系統上，只要一打開就會立刻閃退，因為它被包裝後的檔案結構給搞糊塗了，找不到用來顯示多國語言的字典檔；現在它已經學會正確摸黑找到對的資料夾，順利開機。同時，我們把翻譯補得更完整了——以前你在英文、日文或韓文的系統裡點開「更換面板」選單時，裡面還是會硬生生夾雜中文的面板名稱，或者在找不到檔案時拋出中文的錯誤提示；現在這些文字都會乖乖跟著你的系統語言切換。另外，我們也把散落在各處的快取檔案統整到 `~/.claude/` 底下，順手清掉了你硬碟裡 1.1 MB 的孤兒檔案。就像是買回來的進口家電原本會因為電壓不對直接燒斷保險絲，而且說明書還是各國語言亂湊的；現在插上插座就能正常運作，而且說明書保證整本都是你熟悉的語言。
body.zh-CN: 这次解决了一个致命错误。前几个版本的 `.app` 档在最新的 macOS Sequoia 系统上，只要一打开就会立刻闪退，因为它被包装后的文件结构给搞糊涂了，找不到用来显示多国语言的字典档；现在它已经学会正确摸黑找到对的文件夹，顺利开机。同时，我们把翻译补得更完整了——以前你在英文、日文或韩文的系统里点开「更换面板」菜单时，里面还是会硬生生夹杂中文的面板名称，或者在找不到文件时抛出中文的错误提示；现在这些文字都会乖乖跟着你的系统语言切换。另外，我们也把散落在各处的缓存文件统整到 `~/.claude/` 底下，顺手清掉了你硬盘里 1.1 MB 的孤儿文件。就像是买回来的进口家电原本会因为电压不对直接烧断保险丝，而且说明书还是各国语言乱凑的；现在插上插座就能正常运作，而且说明书保证整本都是你熟悉的语言。
body.en: We've squashed a fatal bug where the released `.app` would instantly crash on launch if you were running the latest macOS Sequoia. The app was getting completely confused by its own packaged file structure and couldn't find its translation dictionary; it has now learned the correct path through the dark to boot up smoothly. Meanwhile, we've filled in the missing translation gaps. Previously, if you used an English, Japanese, or Korean system, your "Switch Panel" menu would awkwardly feature Chinese panel names, and system errors would spit out Chinese text. Now, all these strings strictly respect your chosen system language. We also tidied up the pricing cache files, unifying them under the `~/.claude/` folder and sweeping away a 1.1 MB orphaned file from your hard drive. It's like buying an imported appliance that used to blow a fuse immediately due to the wrong voltage while packing a poorly translated, mixed-language manual; now you can plug it in safely, and the instruction book reads perfectly in your native tongue.
body.ja: 今回、最新の macOS Sequoia 環境において、配布された `.app` ファイルを開いた瞬間にクラッシュする致命的なエラーを解決した。アプリがパッケージング後のファイル構造に混乱し、多言語表示用の辞書ファイルを見失っていたのが原因だが、今後は正しい格納場所を見つけ出して無事に起動できるようになった。また、翻訳の抜け漏れも補完した。これまでは英語・日本語・韓国語のシステムを使っている場合でも、「パネルを変更」メニューの中に中国語のパネル名が混じっていたり、ファイルが見つからない時のエラーメッセージが中国語で出たりしていたが、今後はすべてのテキストがシステム言語に従って正しく切り替わる。さらに、あちこちに散らばっていたキャッシュファイルを `~/.claude/` の下にまとめ、ハードディスクに残っていた 1.1 MB の孤立したファイルも片付けた。電圧の違いですぐにヒューズが飛んでしまう上に、説明書の言語がバラバラに混ざっていた輸入家電が、今はコンセントに挿すだけで正常に動き、説明書も最初から最後まであなたの母国語で読めるようになったようなものである。
body.ko: 이번엔 치명적인 오류 하나를 잡았다. 예전 버전의 `.app` 파일을 최신 macOS Sequoia 시스템에서 열면 실행하자마자 바로 튕겨 버렸다. 앱이 포장된 파일 구조에 스스로 헷갈려 다국어 번역용 사전 파일을 못 찾았기 때문인데, 이제는 어둠 속에서도 올바른 폴더를 찾아 무사히 켜진다. 동시에 번역도 빈틈없이 채워 넣었다. 예전엔 영어, 일본어, 한국어 시스템을 쓰더라도 '패널 변경' 메뉴에 중국어 패널 이름이 뜬금없이 섞여 나오거나, 파일을 못 찾았을 때 뱉어내는 오류 메시지도 중국어였다. 이제 이 모든 글자가 당신의 시스템 언어에 맞춰 얌전하게 바뀐다. 덤으로, 이리저리 흩어져 있던 캐시 파일들을 `~/.claude/` 밑으로 깔끔하게 모으면서 하드디스크에 버려져 있던 1.1MB짜리 고아 파일도 함께 치웠다. 전압이 안 맞아 꽂자마자 퓨즈가 끊어지고 설명서 언어마저 뒤죽박죽으로 섞여 있던 수입 가전제품이, 이제는 플러그만 꽂으면 쌩쌩 잘 돌아가고 설명서도 당신에게 익숙한 언어로 술술 읽히는 것과 같다.

items.original:
**[P0] Released `.app` crashes on launch on macOS Sequoia / arm64** (thanks @cmhcm — [#6](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/6)): all three prior releases (v0.10.0 / v0.10.1 / v0.11.0) are affected. Root cause: in py2app builds `i18n.py` is compiled into `lib/python313.zip` but `i18n.json` lives in `Contents/Resources/`. The old `Path(__file__).with_name("i18n.json")` resolved to a path *through* the zipfile and raised `NotADirectoryError` on first read. Fix: new `i18n.packaged_resource_path()` helper prefers the `RESOURCEPATH` env var that py2app injects at launch (pointing at `Contents/Resources/`) and falls back to the source-adjacent path. All four packaged-resource callsites updated (`i18n.py` / `tui.py` / `main.py` / `menubar.py`). Source-mode runs are unaffected.
**Packaging metadata completed**: `pyproject.toml` `py-modules` adds the previously-missing `burn_rate` / `update_checker` / `tips_loader` / `usage_lang` / `usage_statusline_forwarder`, and `packages.find` `include` adds `panels*`. Non-editable installs now ship the full code.
**`.app` license metadata aligned**: `setup_app.py` `NSHumanReadableCopyright` updated from the stale `MIT License` to `Copyright © 2025-2026 lollapalooza. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.`, matching what `pyproject.toml` declares.
**`pricing_cache.json` path unified**: `analyzer/cost.py` now caches to `~/.claude/pricing_cache.json` (was repo root), matching `pricing.py`. A stray 1.1 MB orphan cache at repo root was removed.
**Panel names go through i18n**: `panels/__init__.py` exposes an `i18n_key` per panel and i18n.json gains the missing keys across all 5 languages. The "Switch Panel" menu no longer mixes Chinese names into en / ja / ko UIs.
**Status-file error messages go through i18n**: `usage_client.py`'s "status file not found" and "no quota data yet" hints now route through `_t()`, all 5 languages covered.
**Analytics CLI read order matches the main app**: `adapters/rate_limits.py` previously only read `~/.claude/tt-status.json`; it now follows the same `usage-status.json` → `usag-status.json` → `tt-status.json` fallback chain as `usage_client.py`.
**README documents the v0.11.0 update check + GitHub Releases as a network exception**: README.md / README.en.md both gain a new "update check" bullet and list the GitHub Releases API as the second of two network exceptions (the first remains the LiteLLM pricing table).

entries: **In-app update check (Stage 1)**: On launch, usage pings GitHub Releases for a newer version (rate-limited to once per 24h so you're not nagged every time you open the app). When a newer version is found, an NSAlert shows the version + release notes with three buttons: **Download**, **Later**, **Skip this version**. "Download" opens the Release page in your default browser — manually replace the old `.app` with the new one. (Stage 2 will bring Sparkle-style auto download + replace.)

**Two new entries in the "Switch panel" menu**:
- **Automatically Check for Updates** (toggleable): unchecking it disables the launch-time auto check entirely; the manual entry below still works.
- **Check for Updates Now**: manually triggers a check, bypassing the 24h cooldown and skip-version preference. If you're already up to date, an alert says so; on network error you see "Update check failed".

Preferences are stored in the existing `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`, with three new keys: `auto_update_check` (default true), `update_dismissed_at` (Unix timestamp), `update_skipped_version` (skipped version string).

`setup_app.py` now bundles `pyproject.toml` and `update_checker` into the py2app build — so the packaged `.app` can fall back to reading `pyproject.toml` when `importlib.metadata` can't resolve the version.

title.zh-TW: App 學會自己檢查更新了，且不會煩死你
title.zh-CN: App 学会自己检查更新了，且不会烦死你
title.en: The app now checks for updates automatically without annoying you
title.ja: アプリが自分で更新をチェックするようになり、しかも煩わしくない
title.ko: 앱이 알아서 업데이트를 확인하며, 당신을 귀찮게 하지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 你現在不用再時不時跑去 GitHub 網頁看有沒有新版本了。App 啟動時會自動去檢查有沒有新版，如果發現更新，會直接跳出視窗告訴你新版本的改動內容，讓你點「Download」連過去下載。為了不打擾你，這個自動檢查一天最多只會跑一次；如果你覺得這個版本不重要，也可以點「跳過此版本」，它就不會再拿同一個版本煩你。當然，如果你想要手動控制，可以在「更換面板」選單裡關掉「自動檢查更新」，或者隨時點「立刻檢查更新」來強迫它查一次。就像你的汽車導航，現在懂自己在背景偷偷查圖資有沒有更新，有重大改變才問你要不要更新，而不是每次一發動就逼著你按確認。
body.zh-CN: 你现在不用再时不时跑去 GitHub 网页看有没有新版本了。App 启动时会自动去检查有没有新版，如果发现更新，会直接跳出窗口告诉你新版本的改动内容，让你点「Download」连过去下载。为了不打扰你，这个自动检查一天最多只会跑一次；如果你觉得这个版本不重要，也可以点「跳过此版本」，它就不会再拿同一个版本烦你。当然，如果你想要手动控制，可以在「更换面板」菜单里关掉「自动检查更新」，或者随时点「立刻检查更新」来强迫它查一次。就像你的汽车导航，现在懂自己在背景偷偷查图资有没有更新，有重大改变才问你要不要更新，而不是每次一发动就逼着你按确认。
body.en: You no longer have to manually check the GitHub repository for new releases. On launch, the app now automatically checks for new versions and pops up a dialog with the release notes and a one-click button to download it. To respect your focus, this auto-check runs at most once every 24 hours. If a particular update doesn't interest you, you can hit "Skip this version" and it won't bother you about that specific release again. You are in full control — you can toggle off "Automatically Check for Updates" in the Switch Panel menu, or manually trigger a "Check for Updates Now" whenever you want. It's like your car's GPS silently checking for new maps in the background and only asking if you want to upgrade when there's actually a major new route, instead of forcing you to click OK every time you start the engine.
body.ja: 今後、新しいバージョンが出ているか GitHub を逐一見に行く必要はなくなった。アプリ起動時に自動で最新版を確認し、更新があればウィンドウを出して変更内容を知らせ、ワンクリックでダウンロード画面へ案内する。作業の邪魔にならないよう、この自動チェックは1日に最大1回しか行われない。もしその更新が不要だと思えば「このバージョンをスキップ」を押せば、同じバージョンで二度と煩わされることはない。もちろん手動で管理したい場合は、「パネルを変更」メニューから「自動で更新を確認」をオフにしたり、いつでも「今すぐ更新を確認」をクリックして強制的に調べさせたりできる。カーナビが裏でこっそり地図の更新を確認し、本当に大きな変更があった時だけアップデートするか聞いてくるようになり、エンジンをかけるたびに確認ボタンを強要しなくなったようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 새 버전이 나왔는지 확인하러 GitHub 페이지를 들락거릴 필요가 없다. 앱을 켜면 알아서 새 버전을 확인한 뒤, 업데이트가 있으면 창을 띄워 변경 사항을 알려주고 버튼 한 번으로 다운로드 페이지로 넘어갈 수 있게 해준다. 작업에 방해되지 않도록 이 자동 확인은 하루에 딱 한 번만 실행되며, 당장 필요 없는 버전이라면 '이 버전 건너뛰기'를 눌러 다시는 알림을 받지 않을 수 있다. 이 모든 것은 당신이 직접 제어할 수 있다. '패널 변경' 메뉴에서 '자동 업데이트 확인'을 끄거나, 원할 때 언제든 '지금 업데이트 확인'을 눌러 억지로 한 번 확인하게 만들 수도 있다. 자동차 내비게이션이 이제 뒤에서 조용히 새 지도가 나왔는지 확인하다가 정말 중요한 길이 새로 뚫렸을 때만 업데이트할지 묻고, 시동을 걸 때마다 억지로 확인 버튼을 누르게 하지 않는 것과 같다.

items.original:
**In-app update check (Stage 1)**: On launch, usage pings GitHub Releases for a newer version (rate-limited to once per 24h so you're not nagged every time you open the app). When a newer version is found, an NSAlert shows the version + release notes with three buttons: **Download**, **Later**, **Skip this version**. "Download" opens the Release page in your default browser — manually replace the old `.app` with the new one. (Stage 2 will bring Sparkle-style auto download + replace.)
**Two new entries in the "Switch panel" menu**:
- **Automatically Check for Updates** (toggleable): unchecking it disables the launch-time auto check entirely; the manual entry below still works.
- **Check for Updates Now**: manually triggers a check, bypassing the 24h cooldown and skip-version preference. If you're already up to date, an alert says so; on network error you see "Update check failed".
Preferences are stored in the existing `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`, with three new keys: `auto_update_check` (default true), `update_dismissed_at` (Unix timestamp), `update_skipped_version` (skipped version string).
`setup_app.py` now bundles `pyproject.toml` and `update_checker` into the py2app build — so the packaged `.app` can fall back to reading `pyproject.toml` when `importlib.metadata` can't resolve the version.

entries: **Weekly burn-rate warning false positive**: Extrapolating the last 10 minutes of usage slope onto a 7-day weekly quota was too aggressive (e.g. 56% used → projected 5h50m to exhaustion → "Runs out in 5h50m (resets in 4d6h)" warning), since users don't sustain that rate 24/7. Fix: `_quota_row` gained a `warning_max_seconds` parameter, and the three weekly call sites pass a 24h ceiling — projections beyond 24 hours no longer trigger the warning. Session warnings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 每週額度的用完警告不再過度恐慌
title.zh-CN: 每周额度的用完警告不再过度恐慌
title.en: Weekly quota burn-rate warnings are no longer overly dramatic
title.ja: 週間制限の使い切り警告が過敏に反応しなくなった
title.ko: 주간 한도 소진 경고가 더 이상 호들갑을 떨지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 現在系統預估「每週額度（weekly quota）」什麼時候會用完時，不會再隨便嚇你了。以前它會拿你最近 10 分鐘瘋狂輸出的速度，直接推算你接下來整週都會不眠不休地工作，然後在你額度其實還剩近一半時，就急著跳出「剩不到 6 小時就用完」的紅字警告。現在系統加上了 24 小時的預測上限，如果按照目前速度算出來還能撐超過一整天，它就不會跳警告來煩你；但針對單次對話（session）的額度警告則維持原樣。這就像手機電量預估，以前你只是剛好開了五分鐘的耗電遊戲，系統就斷言你手機半小時後會沒電並狂響警報，現在它學會考量你不會一直玩下去，不再過度反應。
body.zh-CN: 现在系统预估「每周额度（weekly quota）」什么时候会用完时，不会再随便吓你了。以前它会拿你最近 10 分钟疯狂输出的速度，直接推算你接下来整周都会不眠不休地工作，然后在你额度其实还剩近一半时，就急着跳出「剩不到 6 小时就用完」的红字警告。现在系统加上了 24 小时的预测上限，如果按照目前速度算出来还能撑超过一整天，它就不会跳警告来烦你；但针对单次对话（session）的额度警告则维持原样。这就像手机电量预估，以前你只是刚好开了五分钟的耗电游戏，系统就断言你手机半小时后会没电并狂响警报，现在它学会考量你不会一直玩下去，不再过度反应。
body.en: The system will no longer cause unnecessary panic when predicting when your weekly quota will run out. Previously, it would take your furious typing speed over the last 10 minutes and extrapolate that you'd be working non-stop 24/7, prematurely flashing a red "runs out in 6 hours" warning even when your quota was only half empty. Now, the system enforces a 24-hour prediction ceiling — if your current pace indicates you'll survive for more than a full day, it won't bother you with a warning. Short-term session quota warnings remain unchanged. It's like your phone's battery estimator: it used to panic and scream that your phone would die in 30 minutes just because you launched a heavy game for five minutes, but now it understands you won't be playing forever and stops overreacting.
body.ja: 今後、システムが「週間制限（weekly quota）」の枯渇時期を予測する際、無駄に脅かしてくることはなくなった。これまでは、直近10分間の猛烈な使用ペースを見て、この先1週間ずっと不眠不休で作業し続けると決めつけ、制限枠がまだ半分近く残っているのに「あと6時間で使い切る」という赤字の警告を急いで出していた。今後は予測に24時間の上限が設けられ、現在のペースで計算してまだ丸1日以上もつ場合は警告で煩わせることはなくなった。ただし、1回のセッション制限に対する警告は従来通り機能する。スマホのバッテリー残量予測が、以前は重いゲームを5分開いただけで「あと30分で電池が切れる」と大騒ぎしていたのが、今は「ずっとゲームし続けるわけではない」と理解して過剰反応しなくなったようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 시스템이 '주간 한도(weekly quota)'가 언제 다 닳을지 예측할 때 쓸데없이 겁주지 않는다. 예전엔 최근 10분 동안 당신이 미친 듯이 작업한 속도만 보고 앞으로 일주일 내내 잠도 안 자고 일할 거라고 멋대로 추측해, 한도가 아직 절반 가까이 남았는데도 '6시간 뒤 소진됨'이라는 빨간 경고를 다급하게 띄우곤 했다. 이제는 시스템에 24시간 예측 상한선을 두어, 지금 속도로 계산했을 때 하루 이상 버틸 수 있다면 경고를 띄워 귀찮게 하지 않는다. 단, 단일 대화(session) 한도에 대한 경고는 그대로 유지된다. 스마트폰 배터리 예상 시간이, 예전엔 무거운 게임을 딱 5분 켰을 뿐인데 30분 뒤에 방전될 거라고 발칵 뒤집히던 것에서, 이제는 당신이 게임만 계속하지는 않을 거란 사실을 깨닫고 과민 반응을 멈춘 것과 같다.

items.original: **Weekly burn-rate warning false positive**: Extrapolating the last 10 minutes of usage slope onto a 7-day weekly quota was too aggressive (e.g. 56% used → projected 5h50m to exhaustion → "Runs out in 5h50m (resets in 4d6h)" warning), since users don't sustain that rate 24/7. Fix: `_quota_row` gained a `warning_max_seconds` parameter, and the three weekly call sites pass a 24h ceiling — projections beyond 24 hours no longer trigger the warning. Session warnings are unchanged.

entries: **HTML report Share button**: A new Share button in the top-right opens a file-share modal with two actions — "Download .html" and "Copy file path" — so you can send the report via AirDrop / Mail / Slack / iMessage to a colleague or manager. Recipients open it in any browser on mobile or desktop.

**"Hide project names" toggle on download**: A checkbox inside the share modal (default ON, privacy-first) swaps every project name to `Project 1 / Project 2 / ...` before the HTML is serialized for download. The on-screen report is unaffected.

**HTML report sponsor section reworked**: Two Ko-fi badges now flank the brand slogan `No cloud. No tracking. Just yours.` (kept in English across all five UI languages). The slogan carries a subtle wobble animation to draw the eye, and the GitHub link (github.com/aqua5230/usage) appears below.

**statusLine second line removed**: The cumulative token totals / cache / cost line has been dropped to simplify visuals. Key info now lives on line 1 (5h / 7d / Context window) and line 3 (session duration, model).

**HTML report KPI card widths rebalanced**: tokens / cost are now wider; sessions / messages / active days narrower (grid ratio 1.5fr 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr), preventing 9-digit token counts from wrapping.
HTML report footer line `usage · Local-first analytics · Data stays on device` — replaced by the GitHub link in the sponsor section.

title.zh-TW: 報告可點 Share 分享，還能自動把專案名稱打碼
title.zh-CN: 报告可点 Share 分享，还能自动把项目名称打码
title.en: Share your report in one click with built-in project name redaction
title.ja: レポートをワンクリックで共有、プロジェクト名も自動で隠せる
title.ko: 클릭 한 번으로 보고서를 공유하고, 프로젝트 이름도 알아서 가려준다

body.zh-TW: 現在你可以把分析報告輕鬆傳給主管或同事看了。報告右上角多了一顆分享按鈕，點開就能選擇「另存一份 .html」或「複製檔案路徑」，透過 AirDrop、信箱或通訊軟體傳送，對方用手機或電腦的瀏覽器都能直接打開看。而且，下載介面裡多了一個預設打勾的「隱藏專案名稱」選項，勾著下載的話，檔案裡的專案名字都會被自動替換成「Project 1、Project 2」這類代號，不用擔心機密外洩，而你螢幕上看的畫面仍然維持原樣。就像你拿提款機的明細給別人看，以前要自己拿黑筆塗掉帳號，現在列印時機器就自動幫你打好星號了。
body.zh-CN: 现在你可以把分析报告轻松传给主管或同事看了。报告右上角多了一颗分享按钮，点开就能选择「另存一份 .html」或「复制文件路径」，透过 AirDrop、邮箱或通讯软件发送，对方用手机或电脑的浏览器都能直接打开看。而且，下载界面里多了一个默认打勾的「隐藏项目名称」选项，勾着下载的话，文件里的项目名字都会被自动替换成「Project 1、Project 2」这类代号，不用担心机密外泄，而你屏幕上看的画面仍然维持原样。就像你拿提款机的明细给别人看，以前要自己拿黑笔涂掉账号，现在打印时机器就自动帮你打好星号了。
body.en: You can now easily share your usage analysis with managers or colleagues. A new Share button in the top-right corner of the report lets you "Download .html" or "Copy file path" to send via AirDrop, email, or messaging apps, and recipients can open it in any browser on mobile or desktop. Plus, there's a privacy-first "Hide project names" checkbox in the download modal that's checked by default. When enabled, all project names in the downloaded file are automatically swapped to generic labels like "Project 1" or "Project 2" to prevent leaking sensitive information, while your on-screen view remains unchanged. It's like handing someone your bank receipt — you used to have to cross out the account number with a sharpie, but now the machine prints asterisks for you automatically.
body.ja: 分析レポートを上司や同僚に簡単に送れるようになった。レポートの右上に共有ボタンが追加され、「.html をダウンロード」または「ファイルパスをコピー」を選んで、AirDrop やメール、チャットツール経由で送信できる。相手はスマホでもパソコンでもブラウザで開くだけで読める。さらに、ダウンロード画面にはデフォルトでチェックが入っている「プロジェクト名を隠す」オプションがあり、これをオンにしてダウンロードすると、ファイル内のプロジェクト名が自動的に「Project 1」「Project 2」のような代名詞に置き換わるため、機密漏洩の心配がない。もちろん、あなたの画面上の表示はそのまま維持される。他人に銀行の明細を見せる際、以前は口座番号を自力で黒塗りしていたのが、今は印刷時に機械が自動で伏せ字にしてくれるようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 분석 보고서를 상사나 동료에게 쉽게 보낼 수 있다. 보고서 오른쪽 위에 공유 버튼이 생겨, '.html 다운로드'나 '파일 경로 복사'를 선택해 AirDrop, 이메일, 메신저 등으로 보낼 수 있다. 받는 사람은 휴대폰이든 컴퓨터든 브라우저로 열기만 하면 된다. 또한 다운로드 창에 기본으로 체크되어 있는 '프로젝트 이름 숨기기' 옵션이 추가되어, 체크한 채로 다운로드하면 파일 안의 프로젝트 이름이 모두 'Project 1', 'Project 2' 같은 가명으로 바뀐다. 기밀 유출 걱정 없이 안심하고 공유할 수 있으며, 내 화면에 보이는 내용은 원래대로 유지된다. 다른 사람에게 은행 명세서를 보여줄 때 예전엔 계좌번호를 직접 까만 펜으로 칠해야 했지만, 이제는 기계가 알아서 별표를 쳐서 인쇄해 주는 것과 같다.

items.original:
**HTML report Share button**: A new Share button in the top-right opens a file-share modal with two actions — "Download .html" and "Copy file path" — so you can send the report via AirDrop / Mail / Slack / iMessage to a colleague or manager. Recipients open it in any browser on mobile or desktop.
**"Hide project names" toggle on download**: A checkbox inside the share modal (default ON, privacy-first) swaps every project name to `Project 1 / Project 2 / ...` before the HTML is serialized for download. The on-screen report is unaffected.

title.zh-TW: 介面大掃除，終端機與報告畫面更俐落
title.zh-CN: 界面大扫除，终端与报告画面更利落
title.en: Visual cleanup makes the terminal and reports much sleeker
title.ja: インターフェースの大掃除で、端末やレポートの画面がすっきり
title.ko: 인터페이스 대청소로 터미널과 보고서 화면이 깔끔해졌다

body.zh-TW: 這次為終端機的狀態列（statusLine，在輸入框上方顯示額度的區塊）和分析報告做了視覺瘦身。狀態列移除了原本顯示累計問答、快取和花費的第二行，讓版面更清爽，只把最重要的限額和模型資訊留在第一跟第三行。報告畫面的上方指標卡片（KPI 卡）也調整了寬度比例，把 token 與成本的卡片拉寬，避免累積到上億的長數字被折到下一行；報告底部則重新設計了贊助區塊，用會微微晃動的品牌標語取代了原本死板的頁尾文字，並補上 GitHub 連結。就像把儀表板上平時用不到的繁雜指針拆掉，並把最重要的油量表放大，讓你開車時一眼就能看清重點。
body.zh-CN: 这次为终端的状态栏（statusLine，在输入框上方显示额度的区块）和分析报告做了视觉瘦身。状态栏移除了原本显示累计问答、缓存和花费的第二行，让版面更清爽，只把最重要的限额和模型信息留在第一跟第三行。报告画面的上方指标卡片（KPI 卡）也调整了宽度比例，把 token 与成本的卡片拉宽，避免累积到上亿的长数字被折到下一行；报告底部则重新设计了赞助区块，用会微微晃动的品牌标语取代了原本死板的页脚文字，并补上 GitHub 链接。就像把仪表盘上平时用不到的繁杂指针拆掉，并把最重要的油量表放大，让你开车时一眼就能看清重点。
body.en: We've put the terminal status line (the block above your input showing quotas) and the HTML report on a visual diet. The status line drops its second row that showed cumulative totals, cache, and costs, keeping the layout clean and focusing only on crucial limits and model info on the first and third lines. In the report, the top KPI cards have rebalanced widths — the tokens and cost cards are now wider so massive 9-digit numbers won't awkwardly wrap to the next line. We also reworked the sponsor section at the bottom, replacing the static footer text with a subtly wobbling brand slogan and adding a GitHub link. It's like removing the clutter of rarely-used gauges from your car's dashboard and enlarging the gas gauge so you can read what matters at a glance.
body.ja: 今回、端末のステータスバー（statusLine、入力欄の上で制限枠を示すブロック）と分析レポートの見た目をスマートにした。ステータスバーは、累計のやり取りやキャッシュ、コストを表示していた2行目を削除してレイアウトをすっきりさせ、最も重要な制限枠やモデル情報だけを1行目と3行目に残した。レポート画面の上部にある指標カード（KPIカード）は幅の比率を調整し、トークンとコストのカードを広くすることで、1億を超えるような長い数字が不自然に改行されるのを防いだ。レポート下部もスポンサーエリアを再設計し、堅苦しいフッター文字を、かすかに揺れるブランドスローガンに置き換え、GitHub のリンクを添えた。車のダッシュボードから普段使わないごちゃごちゃしたメーターを外し、一番重要なガソリンメーターを大きくして、運転中に一目で要点が分かるようにしたようなものである。
body.ko: 이번엔 터미널의 상태 표시줄(statusLine, 입력창 위에서 한도를 보여주는 구역)과 분석 보고서의 시각적 군더더기를 뺐다. 상태 표시줄은 누적 문답, 캐시, 비용을 보여주던 두 번째 줄을 아예 치워버려 화면을 시원하게 만들었고, 가장 중요한 한도와 모델 정보만 첫 번째와 세 번째 줄에 남겼다. 보고서 화면 맨 위의 지표 카드(KPI 카드) 역시 너비 비율을 손봐, 토큰과 비용 카드를 넓힘으로써 1억 단위가 넘는 긴 숫자가 다음 줄로 어색하게 꺾이는 일을 막았다. 보고서 맨 아래는 후원 구역을 새로 꾸며, 딱딱하던 바닥글 대신 살짝 흔들리는 브랜드 슬로건을 넣고 GitHub 링크를 달았다. 자동차 계기판에서 평소에 안 보는 복잡한 바늘들을 다 떼어내고, 가장 중요한 기름 게이지를 큼직하게 키워 운전할 때 한눈에 알아보기 쉽게 만든 것과 같다.

items.original:
**HTML report sponsor section reworked**: Two Ko-fi badges now flank the brand slogan `No cloud. No tracking. Just yours.` (kept in English across all five UI languages). The slogan carries a subtle wobble animation to draw the eye, and the GitHub link (github.com/aqua5230/usage) appears below.
**statusLine second line removed**: The cumulative token totals / cache / cost line has been dropped to simplify visuals. Key info now lives on line 1 (5h / 7d / Context window) and line 3 (session duration, model).
**HTML report KPI card widths rebalanced**: tokens / cost are now wider; sessions / messages / active days narrower (grid ratio 1.5fr 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr), preventing 9-digit token counts from wrapping.
HTML report footer line `usage · Local-first analytics · Data stays on device` — replaced by the GitHub link in the sponsor section.

entries: **TUI polling never updated after first fetch**: a `continue` in `poll_usage` caused every timeout to jump back to the loop head, leaving the UI frozen at the initial state. Changed to `pass` so the polling path is actually reached.
**Inconsistent env var name**: `USAG_FORCE_GROUP` (v0.1.x legacy prefix) renamed to `USAGE_FORCE_GROUP` to match all other env vars in the project.

**Redundant filesystem scans per refresh**: `_refresh_in_background` was calling `history_loader.load_entries` four times per cycle (24h × 2, 168h × 1, 720h × 1). Now loads the 720h superset once and passes it down, eliminating the duplicate I/O.
`pricing.py` User-Agent updated from the stale `usage/0.2` to `usage/0.9`.
`--setup` no longer prints a "no migration needed" message on clean installs.

title.zh-TW: 終端機介面不再卡死，底層檔案掃描更省力
title.zh-CN: 终端界面不再卡死，底层文件扫描更省力
title.en: Terminal UI stops freezing, and underlying file scans are much more efficient
title.ja: 端末画面がフリーズしなくなり、ファイルのバックグラウンドスキャンも効率化
title.ko: 터미널 화면이 더 이상 멈추지 않고, 밑바탕 파일 스캔도 훨씬 효율적으로 바뀜

body.zh-TW: 之前在終端機裡看用量時，因為一個程式迴圈寫錯（不小心跳過了更新步驟），導致畫面永遠凍結在剛打開的那一秒，再也不會自動更新。現在這個迴圈修好了，畫面會乖乖定時刷新。同時，我們也優化了底層的檔案掃描：以前每次更新畫面，系統都會笨笨地把同一個歷史紀錄檔案重複讀 4 次來算不同時間區間的數字；現在它學聰明了，一次讀完最長的區間然後直接往下分派，大幅省下白費力氣的硬碟讀取。另外，舊版的環境變數和過時的內部代號也一併統一了。就像是顧門口的警衛以前一直忘記看手錶導致從來不換班，而且查房時還同一層樓爬上爬下巡了四遍，現在終於準時交接，而且知道從頂樓一次巡下來最省事。
body.zh-CN: 之前在终端里看用量时，因为一个程序循环写错（不小心跳过了更新步骤），导致画面永远冻结在刚打开的那一秒，再也不会自动更新。现在这个循环修好了，画面会乖乖定时刷新。同时，我们也优化了底层的文件扫描：以前每次更新画面，系统都会笨笨地把同一个历史记录文件重复读 4 次来算不同时间区间的数字；现在它学聪明了，一次读完最长的区间然后直接往下分派，大幅省下白费力气的硬盘读取。另外，旧版的环境变量和过时的内部代号也一并统一了。就像是顾门口的警卫以前一直忘记看手表导致从来不换班，而且查房时还同一楼层爬上爬下巡了四遍，现在终于准时交接，而且知道从顶楼一次巡下来最省事。
body.en: Previously, when viewing your usage in the terminal, a buggy programming loop (which accidentally skipped the update step) caused the screen to freeze permanently at the exact second you opened it, never automatically refreshing again. This loop is now fixed, and the screen faithfully updates on time. Simultaneously, we've optimized the underlying file scans: before, every time the screen refreshed, the system foolishly read the exact same history file 4 times to calculate numbers for different time ranges; it's now smart enough to read the longest range once and pass the data down, drastically cutting down on wasted hard drive reads. Additionally, legacy environment variables and stale internal names have been unified. It's like a security guard who used to forget to check his watch and never changed shifts, while also climbing up and down the same floor four times during a patrol — now he hands over exactly on time and knows it's easiest to just patrol from the top floor down once.
body.ja: 以前、端末で自身の使用量を見る際、プログラムのループの記述ミス（誤って更新のステップを飛ばしていた）により、開いた瞬間の状態で画面が永久に凍りつき、自動更新されなくなる問題があった。今回このループを修正し、画面がきちんと定期的に更新されるようになった。同時に、裏側のファイルスキャンも最適化した。以前は画面を更新するたびに、システムが愚直に同じ履歴ファイルを4回も読み込んで異なる期間の数値を計算していたが、今では最も長い期間のデータを一度だけ読み込んで振り分けるように賢くなり、無駄なハードディスクの読み込みを大幅に削減した。さらに、旧バージョンの環境変数や古びた内部コードも統一された。門番が以前は時計を見るのを忘れて一向に交代せず、見回りの時も同じ階を4回も上り下りしていたのが、今は時間通りに引き継ぎを行い、最上階から一度に巡回して降りてくるのが一番楽だと学習したようなものである。
body.ko: 예전엔 터미널에서 사용량을 볼 때 프로그램 반복문에 오류가 있어(실수로 업데이트 단계를 건너뜀) 화면이 갓 열렸던 그 1초에 영원히 얼어붙은 채 다신 알아서 새로고침되지 않았다. 이제 이 반복문을 고쳐서 화면이 얌전히 제때 갱신된다. 이와 함께 밑바탕의 파일 스캔도 다듬었다. 예전엔 화면을 새로고침할 때마다 시스템이 멍청하게 똑같은 대화 기록 파일을 4번씩 다시 읽어가며 여러 시간대의 숫자를 계산했다. 이제는 제일 긴 구간을 한 번에 다 읽고 아래로 나눠 주는 법을 배워서, 헛수고하던 하드디스크 읽기를 크게 줄였다. 또한, 구버전 환경 변수와 낡은 내부 이름도 함께 통일했다. 정문을 지키던 경비원이 예전엔 시계 보는 걸 깜빡해 아예 교대하지도 않고, 순찰할 땐 똑같은 층을 네 번씩 오르락내리락하던 것을, 이제는 제시간에 딱 맞춰 교대하고 꼭층에서부터 한 번에 쭉 순찰하며 내려오는 게 제일 편하다는 걸 알게 된 것과 같다.

items.original:
**TUI polling never updated after first fetch**: a `continue` in `poll_usage` caused every timeout to jump back to the loop head, leaving the UI frozen at the initial state. Changed to `pass` so the polling path is actually reached.
**Inconsistent env var name**: `USAG_FORCE_GROUP` (v0.1.x legacy prefix) renamed to `USAGE_FORCE_GROUP` to match all other env vars in the project.
**Redundant filesystem scans per refresh**: `_refresh_in_background` was calling `history_loader.load_entries` four times per cycle (24h × 2, 168h × 1, 720h × 1). Now loads the 720h superset once and passes it down, eliminating the duplicate I/O.
`pricing.py` User-Agent updated from the stale `usage/0.2` to `usage/0.9`.
`--setup` no longer prints a "no migration needed" message on clean installs.

entries: **New "World Cup 2026" panel**: FIFA broadcast HUD style. Top-down green pitch with grass stripes, white field markings (halfway line, centre circle, penalty boxes, corner arcs), dark broadcast scoreboard showing Claude / Codex Session percentages as large numerals (38 px), bidirectional duel bar (Claude ← centre line → Codex) replacing the standard progress bar. Canvas animation: a pentagon-pattern football rolling in the lower pitch area, 12 stick-figure players (6 per team) roaming their zones — the nearest player chases the ball at 0.8 px/frame and kicks it on contact (60-frame cooldown per team), directing it toward the opponent's goal. Bottom section shows a MATCH STATS standings board. Triggers a golden GOAL! celebration overlay when either side's usage hits ≥ 85 %.

title.ko: 사용량 대결이 축구 중계로, 월드컵 패널이 등장했다

body.zh-TW: 你可以把用量監控畫面換成一場足球賽。新加的「世界盃 2026」面板把 Claude 和 Codex（兩套 AI 工具）的用量對決，做成 FIFA 電視轉播的樣子——綠色球場俯視圖配白色場線、深色計分板用大數字秀出兩邊各用了多少 session（一段對話的額度單位）百分比，中間一條雙向對戰條取代原本單向的進度條。畫面上還有一顆五邊形足球在下半場滾、兩隊各 6 個棒人球員在自己的區域跑位，離球最近的球員會追上去、碰到就踢，把球往對方的球門送（各隊踢完有 60 格的冷卻時間）。底部有積分榜；當任一邊用量衝到 85% 以上，還會跳出黃金「進球！」彩蛋慶祝。就像把原本枯燥的用量電表，換成一場會自己播的足球轉播，看著兩邊你來我往，快爆量的時候直接給你一記進球慶祝。
body.zh-CN: 你可以把用量监控画面换成一场足球赛。新加的「世界杯 2026」面板把 Claude 和 Codex（两套 AI 工具）的用量对决，做成 FIFA 电视转播的样子——绿色球场俯视图配白色场线、深色计分板用大数字秀出两边各用了多少 session（一段对话的额度单位）百分比，中间一条双向对战条取代原本单向的进度条。画面上还有一颗五边形足球在下半场滚、两队各 6 个棒人球员在自己的区域跑位，离球最近的球员会追上去、碰到就踢，把球往对方的球门送（各队踢完有 60 格的冷却时间）。底部有积分榜；当任一边用量冲到 85% 以上，还会跳出黄金「进球！」彩蛋庆祝。就像把原本枯燥的用量电表，换成一场会自己播的足球转播，看着两边你来我往，快爆量的时候直接给你一记进球庆祝。
body.en: You can swap the usage monitor for a football match. The new "World Cup 2026" panel turns the usage duel between Claude and Codex (two AI tools) into a FIFA-style TV broadcast — a top-down green pitch with white field lines, a dark scoreboard showing each side's session (a quota unit measured per conversation) percentage in big numerals, and a bidirectional duel bar replacing the old one-way progress bar. A pentagon-pattern football rolls across the lower pitch while twelve stick-figure players (six per team) roam their zones; the nearest player chases the ball and kicks it toward the opponent's goal (each team has a 60-frame cooldown after a kick). A MATCH STATS standings board sits at the bottom, and when either side's usage hits 85% or more, a golden GOAL! celebration overlay pops up. It's like swapping a boring electricity meter for a sports channel that plays its own match, with back-and-forth action and a goal celebration right when you're about to max out.
body.ja: 使用量監視画面をサッカーの試合に切り替えられる。「ワールドカップ 2026」パネルは、Claude と Codex（二つの AI ツール）の使用量対決を FIFA 風のテレビ中継に仕立てる。上から見た緑のピッチに白のライン、ダークカラーのスコアボードが両者の session（一回の対話につき計上される枠の単位）パーセンテージを大きな数字で示し、従来の一方向のプログレスバーに代わって双方向の対決バーが置かれる。五角形の模様のサッカーボールが下半分を転がり、12人の棒人間プレイヤー（各チーム6人）が持ち場を動き回る。ボールに最も近いプレイヤーが追いかけて蹴り、相手のゴールへ向かわせる（蹴った後は各チーム60フレームのクールダウン）。下部には MATCH STATS の順位表があり、どちらかの使用量が85%以上に達すると黄金の GOAL! お祝い演出が飛び出す。単調な使用量メーターを、勝手に試合を流すスポーツチャンネルに取り替えたようなものである。
body.ko: 사용량 화면을 축구 경기로 바꿀 수 있다. 새로운 '월드컵 2026' 패널은 Claude와 Codex(두 가지 AI 도구)의 사용량 대결을 FIFA 스타일 TV 중계로 만든다. 위에서 내려다본 초록 피치에 하얀 선, 어두운 색 점수판이 양측의 session(대화 한 번 단위로 잡히는 한도) 백분율을 큰 숫자로 보여 주고, 예전의 일방향 진행 막대 대신 양방향 대결 막대가 자리한다. 오각형 무늬 축구공이 아래쪽을 굴러가고, 12명의 막대 인간 선수(팀당 6명)가 제자리를 돌아다닌다. 공에 가장 가까운 선수가 쫓아가 차서 상대 골대 쪽으로 보낸다(찬 뒤에는 팀당 60 프레임의 쿨다운). 아래에는 MATCH STATS 순위표가 있고, 어느 한쪽 사용량이 85% 이상에 달하면 황금색 GOAL! 축하 연출이 튀어나온다. 지루한 사용량 계량기를, 알아서 경기를 중계하는 스포츠 채널로 바꾼 것과 같다.

Canvas animation: a pentagon-pattern football rolling in the lower pitch area, 12 stick-figure players (6 per team) roaming their zones — the nearest player chases the ball at 0.8 px/frame and kicks it on contact (60-frame cooldown per team), directing it toward the opponent's goal. entries: **New "Prism Arcade" panel**: deep purple-black background, Canvas conic rainbow halo rotating slowly, geometric prism shards (triangles/diamonds) drifting randomly, coloured light particles flickering, cards with holographic gradient borders (CSS background-clip technique), full-spectrum rainbow progress bars with sweep animation.

**New "Black Hole" panel**: pure-black space background, Canvas 2D star field (120 stars with twinkling), rotating accretion disk (orange-yellow-white gradient ellipse, Doppler brighter-left/darker-right), photon ring, event horizon with blue-purple glow, orange particles orbiting the ellipse, amber glass cards.

title.zh-TW: 新增稜鏡街機面板
title.zh-CN: 新增棱镜街机面板
title.en: New Prism Arcade panel added
title.ja: プリズムアーケードパネルを追加
title.ko: 프리즘 아케이드 패널 추가

body.zh-TW: 現在多了一款「稜鏡街機（Prism Arcade）」面板可以選了！它有著深紫黑色的背景，中央有一圈緩慢旋轉的彩虹光暈，搭配隨機漂移的幾何碎片（三角形與菱形）和閃爍的彩色光點粒子。卡片邊框採用了全息漸層效果，進度條更是全光譜的彩虹色並帶有掃光動畫，看起來非常酷炫。就像是在你的電腦桌面上擺了一台充滿復古霓虹燈效的經典大型機台。
body.zh-CN: 现在多了一款「棱镜街机（Prism Arcade）」面板可以选了！它有着深紫黑色的背景，中央有一圈缓慢旋转的彩虹光晕，搭配随机漂移的几何碎片（三角形与菱形）和闪烁的彩色光点粒子。卡片边框采用了全息渐变效果，进度条更是全光谱的彩虹色并带有扫光动画，看起来非常酷炫。就像是在你的电脑桌面上摆了一台充满复古霓虹灯效的经典大型街机。
body.en: You can now choose the new "Prism Arcade" panel! It features a deep purple-black background with a slowly rotating rainbow halo in the center, accompanied by randomly drifting geometric shards (triangles and diamonds) and flickering colored light particles. The cards sport holographic gradient borders, and the progress bars boast a full-spectrum rainbow sweep animation, making the whole thing look incredibly cool. It's like placing a classic arcade cabinet glowing with retro neon lights right on your computer desktop.
body.ja: 新たに「プリズムアーケード（Prism Arcade）」パネルが選べるようになった。深い紫黒色の背景に、中央でゆっくりと回転する虹色の光の輪、そしてランダムに漂う幾何学的な破片（三角形やひし形）と点滅するカラフルな光の粒子が特徴である。カードの枠線にはホログラムのようなグラデーション効果が施され、プログレスバーは全スペクトルの虹色に光が走るアニメーション付きで、非常にクールな仕上がりになっている。レトロなネオンの光に包まれた昔ながらのアーケードゲーム機をパソコンのデスクトップに置いたようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 '프리즘 아케이드(Prism Arcade)' 패널을 고를 수 있다! 짙은 자주색이 섞인 검은색 배경에 한가운데서 천천히 도는 무지갯빛 후광, 무작위로 떠다니는 기하학적 파편(삼각형과 마름모)과 깜빡이는 알록달록한 빛 입자들이 어우러져 있다. 카드 테두리는 홀로그램 그라데이션 효과를 입혔고, 진행 표시줄은 빛이 훑고 지나가는 애니메이션이 달린 모든 스펙트럼의 무지개색이라 무척 멋져 보인다. 레트로 네온 조명으로 가득한 클래식 오락기를 컴퓨터 바탕화면에 가져다 놓은 것과 같다.

title.ko: 블랙홀 패널 추가, 애니메이션 배경이 더 선명해지고 화면 배치도 깔끔해짐

body.zh-TW: 現在多了一款「黑洞視界（Black Hole）」面板可以選了！它有著純黑的宇宙背景、120 顆閃爍的星星，中央是一個有著藍紫光暈的事件視界和旋轉的漸層吸積盤，搭配琥珀色的玻璃卡片，科幻感十足。同時，我們把水族箱、稜鏡街機與黑洞視界這三款動畫面板的卡片背景調得更透明，讓背後的動畫能更清楚地透出來；我們也修復了這些面板底部會莫名其妙留白的問題，現在內容會完美撐滿整個視窗高度了。就像是幫家裡的窗戶換了更透光的玻璃，而且原本裝歪、底部漏風的窗框也重新打上矽利康封滿了。
body.zh-CN: 现在多了一款「黑洞视界（Black Hole）」面板可以选了！它有着纯黑的宇宙背景、120 颗闪烁的星星，中央是一个有着蓝紫光晕的事件视界和旋转的渐变吸积盘，搭配琥珀色的玻璃卡片，科幻感十足。同时，我们把水族箱、棱镜街机与黑洞视界这三款动画面板的卡片背景调得更透明，让背后的动画能更清楚地透出来；我们也修复了这些面板底部会莫名其妙留白的问题，现在内容会完美撑满整个窗口高度了。就像是帮家里的窗户换了更透光的玻璃，而且原本装歪、底部漏风的窗框也重新打上硅酮封满了。
body.en: You can now choose the new "Black Hole" panel! It features a pure-black space background with 120 twinkling stars, centered around an event horizon with a blue-purple glow and a rotating gradient accretion disk, paired with amber glass cards for a deeply sci-fi feel. Simultaneously, we've reduced the background opacity of the cards in the Aquarium, Prism Arcade, and Black Hole animated panels, allowing the animations behind them to show through much more clearly. We also fixed an issue where these panels had inexplicable empty space at the bottom, so their content now perfectly stretches to fill the full window height. It's like replacing your home's windows with clearer glass, and finally caulking up the crooked frames that were leaving a drafty gap at the bottom.
body.ja: 新たに「ブラックホール（Black Hole）」パネルが選べるようになった。純黒の宇宙背景に120個の星が瞬き、中央には青紫の光を放つ事象の地平線と回転するグラデーションの降着円盤があり、琥珀色のガラス風カードと組み合わさってSF感満載である。同時に、水族館、プリズムアーケード、ブラックホールの3つのアニメーションパネルにおいて、カードの背景の透明度を高め、背後のアニメーションがよりはっきりと透けて見えるようにした。さらに、これらのパネルの底に不自然な余白ができる問題も修正し、中身がウィンドウの高さ全体にぴったりと収まるようになった。家の窓ガラスをより透明度の高いものに交換し、斜めに取り付けられて隙間風が吹き込んでいた窓枠の底をシリコンでしっかりと塞ぎ直したようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 '블랙홀(Black Hole)' 패널을 고를 수 있다! 순흑색 우주 배경에 120개의 별이 반짝이고, 한가운데는 청보라빛 후광이 도는 사건의 지평선과 회전하는 그라데이션 강착 원반이 있으며, 호박색 유리 카드가 어우러져 SF 느낌이 물씬 풍긴다. 이와 함께 수족관, 프리즘 아케이드, 블랙홀 이 3가지 애니메이션 패널의 카드 배경을 더 투명하게 만들어서 뒤쪽 애니메이션이 한결 또렷하게 비쳐 보이도록 했다. 또한 이 패널들의 바닥에 뜬금없이 빈칸이 남던 문제도 고쳐서, 이제 내용물이 창 높이에 딱 맞게 꽉 찬다. 집 창문을 더 투명한 유리로 바꾸고, 비뚤게 달아 바닥으로 황소바람이 새어 들어오던 창틀을 실리콘으로 빈틈없이 메운 것과 같다.

entries: **New "Midnight Aquarium" panel**: sixth built-in panel with a deep-sea animation theme — Canvas 2D bubbles rising from the bottom (42 bubbles with random drift), 4 CSS jellyfish (floating up/down with cyan glow), bioluminescent particles in the background. title.zh-CN: 新增午夜水族箱面板，打包版 App 终于能听懂你的语言设置

title.ja: 真夜中の水族館パネルを追加、パッケージ版アプリが言語設定を正しく反映
title.ko: 한밤의 수족관 패널 추가, 패키지 앱이 드디어 언어 설정을 알아들음

body.zh-TW: 現在多了一款「午夜水族箱（Aquarium）」面板可以選了！這是一個深海動畫主題，裡面有 42 顆不斷往上飄移的氣泡、4 隻透著青色光芒上下浮動的水母，還有微微發光的浮游生物，搭配半透明的毛玻璃卡片與掃光特效，非常療癒。此外，之前因為系統設定的衝突，導致你開啟打包版 App 時，系統會直接無視你的電腦語言設定、硬生生塞給你英文介面；現在我們換了另一種打招呼的方式，繁體中文的使用者點開 App 時，終於能立刻看到熟悉的中文介面了。就像是你買了個智慧魚缸，以前它只會對你講英文，現在它終於學會看你家的門牌，開口用你的母語跟你問好了。
body.zh-CN: 现在多了一款「午夜水族箱（Aquarium）」面板可以选了！这是一个深海动画主题，里面有 42 颗不断往上飘移的气泡、4 只透着青色光芒上下浮动的水母，还有微微发光的浮游生物，搭配半透明的毛玻璃卡片与扫光特效，非常疗愈。此外，之前因为系统设置的冲突，导致你开启打包版 App 时，系统会直接无视你的电脑语言设置、硬生生塞给你英文界面；现在我们换了另一种打招呼的方式，繁体中文的用户点开 App 时，终于能立刻看到熟悉的中文界面了。就像是你买了个智能鱼缸，以前它只会对你讲英文，现在它终于学会看你家的门牌，开口用你的母语跟你问好了。
body.en: You can now choose the new "Midnight Aquarium" panel! It's a deep-sea animation theme featuring 42 randomly drifting bubbles rising from the bottom, 4 jellyfish floating up and down with a cyan glow, and bioluminescent particles, all paired with frosted glass cards and sweeping light effects for a truly soothing vibe. Additionally, due to a conflicting system setting, launching the bundled app previously caused the system to completely ignore your computer's language preference and force an English interface on you. We've changed how we ask the system for your preference, so Traditional Chinese users will finally be greeted with a familiar Chinese interface the moment they click the app. It's like buying a smart fish tank that used to only speak English, but has finally learned to read your house's nametag and greet you in your native tongue.
body.ja: 新たに「真夜中の水族館（Aquarium）」パネルが選べるようになった。これは深海のアニメーションをテーマにしており、底から漂い上がる42個の気泡、シアン色の光を放ちながら上下に漂う4匹のクラゲ、そして微かに光るプランクトンが描かれ、半透明のすりガラス風カードと光の掃引エフェクトが組み合わさった非常に癒されるデザインである。さらに、以前はシステム設定の衝突により、パッケージ版アプリを起動した際にパソコンの言語設定が完全に無視され、強引に英語のインターフェースが押し付けられていた。今回、システムへの言語の尋ね方を変えたため、繁体字中国語のユーザーがアプリを開いた時に、ようやく見慣れた中国語の画面が即座に表示されるようになった。以前は英語しか話さなかったスマート水槽を買ってきたが、ようやく家の表札を見て、母国語で挨拶してくれるようになったようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 '한밤의 수족관(Aquarium)' 패널을 고를 수 있다! 심해 애니메이션을 주제로 한 이 패널에는 위로 끊임없이 떠오르는 42개의 방울, 청록색 빛을 띠며 위아래로 둥둥 떠다니는 4마리의 해파리, 그리고 은은하게 빛나는 플랑크톤이 반투명한 불투명 유리 카드와 빛이 스쳐 지나가는 효과와 어우러져 무척 마음을 편안하게 해준다. 더불어 예전엔 시스템 설정이 충돌하는 바람에 패키지 앱을 켤 때 시스템이 컴퓨터의 언어 설정을 완전히 무시하고 다짜고짜 영어 화면을 들이밀었지만, 이제는 인사하는 방식을 바꿔 번체 중국어 사용자가 앱을 누르면 마침내 익숙한 중국어 화면을 바로 볼 수 있게 되었다. 예전엔 영어로만 떠들던 스마트 어항을 샀는데, 이제 드디어 당신 집의 문패를 읽고 모국어로 인사할 줄 알게 된 것과 같다.

title.ja: 雲図観測パネルを追加
title.ko: 구름 관측 패널 추가

body.zh-TW: 現在多了一款「雲圖觀測（Cloud Observation）」面板可以選了！它是我們的第五款內建面板，走的是氣象觀測站的風格——有著淡藍色的天空漸層、邊緣柔和的白色雲層，以及淡淡的等高線。整個介面採用清爽的淺色調，搭配半透明的玻璃卡片效果，讓背後的雲層能若隱若現透出來。就像是你的電腦桌面上開了一扇明亮的小窗戶，隨時都能看著外頭輕柔飄動的白雲。
body.zh-CN: 现在多了一款「云图观测（Cloud Observation）」面板可以选了！它是我们的第五款内建面板，走的是气象观测站的风格——有着淡蓝色的天空渐变、边缘柔和的白色云层，以及淡淡的等高线。整个界面采用清爽的浅色调，搭配半透明的玻璃卡片效果，让背后的云层能若隐若现透出来。就像是你的电脑桌面上开了一扇明亮的小窗户，随时都能看着外头轻柔飘动的白云。
body.en: You can now choose the new "Cloud Observation" panel! It's our fifth built-in panel, featuring a weather-station visual style — a light blue sky gradient, white cloud layers with soft edges, and pale contour lines. The entire interface embraces a crisp, light tone with translucent glass cards, allowing the clouds behind to peek through subtly. It's like opening a bright little window right on your computer desktop, letting you watch the soft, drifting white clouds whenever you like.
body.ja: 新たに「雲図観測（Cloud Observation）」パネルが選べるようになった。5つ目の内蔵パネルとなるこれは、気象観測所のスタイルを採用している。淡いブルーの空のグラデーション、輪郭が柔らかい白い雲の層、そして薄い等高線が特徴である。全体的に爽やかな淡い色調で、半透明のガラスのようなカード効果を組み合わせることで、背後の雲がうっすらと透けて見えるようになっている。パソコンのデスクトップに明るい小さな窓を開け、外をふんわりと漂う白雲をいつでも眺められるようなものである。
body.ko: 이제 '구름 관측(Cloud Observation)' 패널을 고를 수 있다! 다섯 번째 기본 패널로, 기상 관측소 느낌을 살렸다. 연한 파란색 하늘 그라데이션, 가장자리가 부드러운 하얀 구름 층, 그리고 옅은 등고선이 어우러져 있다. 전체적으로 산뜻하고 밝은 톤에 반투명한 유리 카드 효과를 더해, 뒤에 있는 구름 층이 어렴풋이 비쳐 보이게 했다. 컴퓨터 바탕화면에 환한 작은 창문을 열어두고, 밖에서 살랑살랑 떠다니는 흰 구름을 언제든 지켜보는 것과 같다.
